description: This file defines a centralized state management store for a gym management system frontend, utilizing the Zustand library. It manages collections of classes, bookings, memberships, and provides fetch/create/update/delete actions for these entities, as well as selection helpers for retrieving detailed entity data.

methods.name: fetchClasses
methods.description: Fetches the list of gym classes based on provided parameters, updates the store with loading status and results.

methods.name: createClass
methods.description: Creates a new gym class with the given payload and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateClass
methods.description: Updates an existing gym class identified by id with new data from payload.

methods.name: deleteClass
methods.description: Deletes a gym class identified by id.

methods.name: fetchBookings
methods.description: Fetches the list of bookings based on provided parameters.

methods.name: createBooking
methods.description: Creates a new booking and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateBooking
methods.description: Updates a booking identified by id with new data.

methods.name: deleteBooking
methods.description: Deletes a booking specified by id.

methods.name: updateMembership
methods.description: Updates an existing membership based on id.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Selects an entity to view details, loads its data asynchronously.
